rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for kerosene, including fuel used for heating, lighting, or similar purposes.

example.english: Some people in the countryside still use kerosene for cooking.
example.traditional: 鄉下有啲人仲用火水煮食。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 haa2 jau5 di1 jan4 zung6 jung6 fo2 seoi2 zyu2 sik6
